name: attack-relevance-v1
how_written: Hand-written BEFORE the first retrieval run, phrased like alert descriptions and rule names that Wazuh, Suricata, Sigma and AMiner produce in general. Written without looking at any label, phase name, case, variant or retrieval result. Expected ids were only checked to exist (non-revoked) in the local bundle. Frozen: do not edit after seeing results; add a new versioned file instead.
match_rule: A query is a hit at k when any of its expected technique ids is among the top-k distinct technique ids retrieved (exact id match; chunks of one technique count once, at their best rank).
